QuestInfo.name: Secret Assembly
QuestInfo.0: #p3001002# tells you he has some information for you if you talk to him when he's done eating.
QuestInfo.1: After telling you he has some information for you, #b#p3001002##k gave you a transmitter called #bD-03#k. Try using it at #b#m401020300##k.
QuestInfo.2: You attempted to communicate with the merchant crew when a masked man appeared out of nowhere.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

Can proceed to the No Free Trade quest

0.0: That hit the spot! I'll give you the info you want. Take it! \r\n#L0##b(He hands you a weird gadget.) This is... information?#l\n#k
0.1: That's better than a few words of wisdom! Have you heard of the #bGrandis Shadow#k merchants? That little gizmo lets you talk to them. They'll know everything you need to know!

yes.0: Grandis's Shadowdealers are ruthless. They'll do just about anything for money. They even handed over the secrets of creating Vision Bombs to the High Flora!
yes.1: All right, here's the #b#t4033373##k. Go to #b#m401020300##k and turn on the device.

no.0: Hey, that thing is a treasure! Don't be scared to make a few new friends.

1.0: Hello there! Oh, are you surprised my overwhelming alacrity? Do not be! I'm a merchant. I know how to move, and, or, shake it! Besides, I know a few secret back parlors to pass through, here and there.\r\n#L0##bOh. Huh. 'Cause I sure didn't see any paths...#l\n#k
1.1: Haha! Wound tight by the wizardry of my words! Let me introduce the visage that stands before you! I am #b#p3001004##k, a humble merchant.\r\n#L0##bCool. I'm Kaiser, an awesome warrior.#l\n#k
1.2: I knew that. The knight, right? Anyway, that transmitter you used is something that merchants typically use only with one another, so I knew I was safe in coming here. Besides, #p3001002# told me to expect a knight.

yes.0: I certainly don't care about your hometown or the heritage you acquired. Let's just talk the good talk of business. Shall we?
